data.name: Angelic Attacks
data.description: Your melee attacks are considered good-aligned weapons for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction. Furthermore, you deal 1d6 extra damage when you deal damage to an evil outsider with a melee attack. This extra damage stacks with effects such as Align Weapon and those granted by a weapon with the holy magic weapon special ability.

Your melee attacks are considered good-aligned weapons for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction. Furthermore, you deal 1d6 extra damage when you deal damage to an evil outsider with a melee attack. This extra damage stacks with effects such as Align Weapon and those granted by a weapon with the holy magic weapon special ability.
